recordings.previousText: Now that's a hardworking piece! Fork time: one busy piece hitting a whole group of targets, and a single reply rarely gets them all out of the way.
recordings.text: Now that's a hardworking piece! Fork time: one busy piece hitting more than one target, and a single reply rarely gets them all out of the way.
recordings.reason: A fork often hits only two pieces, so 'a whole group/bunch/cluster of targets' overclaimed.
